_: Botania, from All the Mods 9's census (W4 R7, judged 2026-11-11). Livingrock is the natural rock of Alfheim's ground, as the census saw it there, and the rules leave it out for having no stone word. Metamorphic forest stone is natural rock of Alfheim's hills, as the other four metamorphic stones are and detection already places, and the rules read the ore inside forest and leave it out. Named one by one, only the blocks that census judged, because a word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. Their bricks, cobblestones, polished forms, slabs, stairs and walls, and livingrock slate, were not judged and are left to the rules.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.20.1 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was. Where an earlier note here leaves this mod's slabs and stairs to the rules, or to detection's family, the ones named below no longer are.
